intro: Between 2026-04-12 and 2026-10-16, ZCyberNews published 92 articles tagged supply-chain. Coverage spans technology, software development, cryptocurrency, logistics, and manufacturing, with activity reported across Global, North america, Europe, United states, and Asia. Lazarus Group, TeamPCP, and Alluring Pisces were observed among the top threat actors. Prominent vulnerabilities include CVE-2026-1731 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-45033 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-39987 (CVSS 9.3), CVE-2026-41650 (CVSS 6.1), and CVE-2026-44664 (CVSS 6.1). The severity mix comprises 54 high, 16 critical, 16 medium, and 4 informational items.
